data.long_meaning: Sadafiyya is an Arabic name that signifies purity and chastity. It is a virtue highly valued in Islamic tradition. The name Sadafiyya carries the meaning “Pure and Chaste” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Sadafiyya usually hope their child will grow to embody pure and chaste and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Sadafiyya belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure and Chaste.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sadafiyya total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
